records.jp: 広島校……つまり、リーダーが前にいた学校で、<CR>特殊部隊が再編成されてな
records.en_original: Hiroshima Academy... In other words, the leader's previous school, where the special unit was reorganized.
records.en: Hiroshima Academy... In other words, the leader's previous school, where the special unit was reorganized.

records.jp: 今回その部隊の新人隊員が、我が部隊の見学をする<CR>ためにやってきたわけだ
records.en_original: This time, one of their new recruits is here to observe our squad.
records.en: This time, one of their new recruits is here to observe our squad.

records.jp: はじめまして。<CR>広島校一年、星崎愛央です！
records.en_original: Nice to meet you! First year at Hiroshima, Ao Hoshizaki!
records.en: Nice to meet you! First year at Hiroshima, Ao Hoshizaki!

records.jp: 司令が話していた別の地区からの客人、か……<CR>まさかリーダーの古巣からとは
records.en_original: So she's the guest from another district that Commander mentioned... I never thought she'd be from the leader's old stomping grounds.
records.en: So she's the guest from another district that Commander mentioned... I never thought she'd be from the leader's old stomping grounds.

records.jp: わざわざ広島から見学だけしに来るなんて……、<CR>ちょっと大げさじゃない？
records.en_original: Coming all the way from Hiroshima just to observe us... Isn't that a bit much?
records.en: Coming all the way from Hiroshima just to observe us... Isn't that a bit much?

records.jp: いやいや、かつて広島を異灰から解放した英雄がいる<CR>すっごい部隊なんだから！
records.en_original: No way! I mean, there's a true hero here who once liberated Hiroshima from the Testa—you guys are an amazing squad!
records.en: No way! I mean, there's a true hero here who once liberated Hiroshima from the Testa—you guys are an amazing squad!

records.jp: そんな部隊を見学できるなんて、最高すぎるって！
records.en_original: Getting the chance to see a unit like this up close is just the best!
records.en: Getting the chance to see a unit like this up close is just the best!

records.jp: そういえば、リーダーにはそういう設定があったな
records.en_original: Oh yeah, Leader did have that backstory, didn't he?
records.en: Oh yeah, Leader did have that backstory, didn't he?

records.jp: そこは、経歴とか栄光とかじゃないかな～？
records.en_original: Shouldn't you call it his history or accomplishments instead?
records.en: Shouldn't you call it his history or accomplishments instead?

records.jp: リーダーさん、本当にすごい人なんですね！！
records.en_original: Leader, you're honestly amazing!!
records.en: Leader, you're honestly amazing!!

records.jp: そういえば、新人って話だけど出身は別の場所なの？<CR>私たちみたいに、地元から転校した感じ？
records.en_original: Oh, by the way, since you're a new recruit, are you from somewhere else? Did you transfer there from your hometown, like us?
records.en: Oh, by the way, since you're a new recruit, are you from somewhere else? Did you transfer there from your hometown, like us?

records.jp: あー……それがさ……
records.en_original: Oh, well, about that...
records.en: Oh, well, about that...

records.jp: 覚えてないんだよね
records.en_original: I don't really remember.
records.en: I don't really remember.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 実は私、最近までずっと昏睡状態で。<CR>目が覚めたら広島校の近くの病院にいたんだ
records.en_original: Actually, I was in a coma until just recently. When I woke up, I was at a hospital near Hiroshima Academy.
records.en: Actually, I was in a coma until just recently. When I woke up, I was at a hospital near Hiroshima Academy.

records.jp: で、昏睡状態になる前までの記憶が全然なくて
records.en_original: And I have absolutely no memories from before I went into the coma.
records.en: And I have absolutely no memories from before I went into the coma.

records.jp: 自分がどこから来たのか、何者なのか、<CR>なんでこんな状態になっちゃったのかもわからなくて
records.en_original: I don't know where I'm from, or who I really am, or even how I ended up like this.
records.en: I don't know where I'm from, or who I really am, or even how I ended up like this.

records.jp: 名前はなんとか思い出したんだけど。警察に頼んでも<CR>身寄りが見つからなくて
records.en_original: I barely managed to remember my name. Even when I asked the police for help, they couldn't find any relatives or close contacts.
records.en: I barely managed to remember my name. Even when I asked the police for help, they couldn't find any relatives or close contacts.

records.jp: そんな時に病院の検査で、変身して戦える素質が<CR>あるってわかって、この学校のことを教えてもらって
records.en_original: But then, when they ran some tests at the hospital, they found out I had the ability to transform and fight. That's how I learned about this school.
records.en: But then, when they ran some tests at the hospital, they found out I had the ability to transform and fight. That's how I learned about this school.

records.jp: 広島校に編入して特殊部隊に入ることになったんだ
records.en_original: So I transferred to Hiroshima Academy and joined the special forces.
records.en: So I transferred to Hiroshima Academy and joined the special forces.

records.jp: ……苦労したようだな
records.en_original: Sounds like you went through a lot.
records.en: Sounds like you went through a lot.

records.jp: 身元も身寄りも不明なんて、不思議な話ね
records.en_original: No background, no relatives—that's a mysterious story.
records.en: No background, no relatives—that's a mysterious story.

records.jp: ねー。自分でも不思議だよー
records.en_original: Right? It's a mystery to me, too.
records.en: Right? It's a mystery to me, too.

records.jp: でもまあ、病院で変身する素質が見つかったおかげで<CR>広島校に入れたわけだし、運がよかったよ
records.en_original: But, I guess I was lucky. Thanks to the hospital discovering my potential, I was able to join Hiroshima Academy.
records.en: But, I guess I was lucky. Thanks to the hospital discovering my potential, I was able to join Hiroshima Academy.

records.jp: ねえ
records.en_original: Hey.
records.en: Hey.

records.jp: 記憶喪失って、本当？
records.en_original: Is it really true that you lost your memory?
records.en: Is it really true that you lost your memory?

records.jp: へ？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: あ、ごめん！<CR>別に今の話を疑ってるわけじゃなくてね
records.en_original: Oh, sorry! I don't mean that I doubt your story or anything.
records.en: Oh, sorry! I don't mean that I doubt your story or anything.

records.jp: かんな、記憶喪失の人初めて見たから。<CR>ちょっとびっくりしちゃって
records.en_original: It's just that you're the first person with amnesia I've ever met. It's kind of surprising.
records.en: It's just that you're the first person with amnesia I've ever met. It's kind of surprising.

records.jp: 本当に何も覚えてないの？
records.en_original: You really don't remember anything?
records.en: You really don't remember anything?

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: ほんとにほんと？
records.en_original: Really, really?
records.en: Really, really?

records.jp: うん、覚えてないんだ
records.en_original: Yup, I don't remember a thing.
records.en: Yup, I don't remember a thing.

records.jp: そっか……
records.en_original: I see...
records.en: I see...

records.jp: かんな
records.en_original: Kanna.
records.en: Kanna.

records.jp: あ、あれ？<CR>どうしたの、愛央
records.en_original: Huh? What's up, Ao?
records.en: Huh? What's up, Ao?

records.jp: 広島校から帰還命令が来てね。<CR>急遽帰ることになっちゃったんだよ
records.en_original: I received orders to return to Hiroshima Academy. I have to head back right away.
records.en: I received orders to return to Hiroshima Academy. I have to head back right away.

records.jp: えっ、急すぎない？
records.en_original: Wait, that's way too sudden!
records.en: Wait, that's way too sudden!

records.jp: なんか、異灰の動きが怪しいらしくて、<CR>警戒のために少しでも戦力が必要なんだって
records.en_original: Seems like there's some suspicious activity from the Testa, so they need all the help they can get for security.
records.en: Seems like there's some suspicious activity from the Testa, so they need all the help they can get for security.

records.jp: けど、校門のところからかんなが見えてさ。<CR>なんか、すごく寂しそうに見えたから……
records.en_original: But, I spotted you from the school gate, Kanna. You looked really lonely...
records.en: But, I spotted you from the school gate, Kanna. You looked really lonely...

records.jp: 会ったばかりでなに言ってんだかって感じだけど、<CR>私でよければ話くらい聞くよ
records.en_original: I know we just met and it might sound weird, but if you want to talk, I can listen—if that's okay with you.
records.en: I know we just met and it might sound weird, but if you want to talk, I can listen—if that's okay with you.

records.jp: ……どっちもすっごく大事なものなんだけど、<CR>どっちか捨てなきゃいけなくなったら
records.en_original: If you had two things you cared about so much, but had to give up one...
records.en: If you had two things you cared about so much, but had to give up one...

records.jp: 愛央はどうする？
records.en_original: What would you do, Ao?
records.en: What would you do, Ao?

records.jp: え？　大事なものってたとえば……？
records.en_original: Huh? Like, what kind of important things?
records.en: Huh? Like, what kind of important things?

records.jp: なんでもいい。<CR>でもとにかく、すっごくすっごく大事なもの
records.en_original: Anything. Just...something super, super important to you.
records.en: Anything. Just...something super, super important to you.

records.jp: 大事なもの、か……
records.en_original: Something important, huh?
records.en: Something important, huh?

records.jp: みんなが最終的に笑顔になれる方を取る、かな
records.en_original: I think I'd choose the option that would make everyone end up smiling in the end.
records.en: I think I'd choose the option that would make everyone end up smiling in the end.

records.jp: たとえ自分にとって苦しい選択肢でも
records.en_original: Even if it was a tough choice for me.
records.en: Even if it was a tough choice for me.

records.jp: それでみんなが“退屈で平凡な毎日”を送れるなら、<CR>それが一番幸せだと思う
records.en_original: If everyone else can live ordinary, peaceful days because of it, then that's probably the happiest ending.
records.en: If everyone else can live ordinary, peaceful days because of it, then that's probably the happiest ending.

records.jp: 私自身も、報われたと思える気がするしね
records.en_original: And I think I'd be able to feel like it was worth it, too.
records.en: And I think I'd be able to feel like it was worth it, too.

records.jp: かんな？
records.en_original: Kanna?
records.en: Kanna?

records.jp: かっこいー！
records.en_original: That's so cool!
records.en: That's so cool!

records.jp: ふふふ……
records.en_original: Hehehe.
records.en: Hehehe.

records.jp: ……なんて。実際に自分がその状況に置かれたら、<CR>こんな風に思えるかわからないけどね
records.en_original: But, who knows? If I was actually in that situation, I don't know if I'd actually feel that way.
records.en: But, who knows? If I was actually in that situation, I don't know if I'd actually feel that way.

records.jp: さてと、そろそろ行かなくちゃ。<CR>向こうの用事が終わったらまた戻ってくるから
records.en_original: Well, I have to get going soon. I'll be back once my business over there is finished.
records.en: Well, I have to get going soon. I'll be back once my business over there is finished.

records.jp: 戻ってきたら、また話そうね
records.en_original: Let's talk again when I get back, okay?
records.en: Let's talk again when I get back, okay?

records.jp: うん……愛央、またね
records.en_original: Yeah... See you, Ao.
records.en: Yeah... See you, Ao.
